name: Vallfogona de Riucorb (Spain)
description: Yellow field with dark green triangles at the lower hoist and lower fly forming a chevron, charged in the upper part with a red flaming object (a burning valley).
history: Municipal flag of Vallfogona de Riucorb; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: chevron formed by dark green triangles in the lower corners
triangles at the lower hoist and lower fly
oval with flames in the upper part
